basic_info.description: Nestled between the sought-after neighborhoods of NOE VALLEY and EUREKA VALLEY, this EXPANSIVE TOP FLOOR two-level VIEW condo offers the feel of a single-family home. PRIVATE ELEVATOR to both levels from the garage, this residence is designed for convenience, entertainment, and LUXURY. The open floor plan seamlessly blends indoor and outdoor living, featuring soaring ceilings, skylights, powder room, pantry, beautiful hardwood floors throughout, and two gas fireplaces. PANORAMIC VIEWS and multiple DECKS, including a private HOT TUB, create an ideal setting for relaxing or entertaining under the stars, all while soaking in spectacular views.The modern floor plan in both HOA units was well thought-out separating the entertainment spaces from the bedrooms. The primary suite is a true retreat, boasting a marble-clad en-suite bathroom with a separate jet tub and shower, walk-in closet, office alcove, a sitting area with a FIREPLACE, and stunning views. Two additional spacious bedrooms, two bathrooms, and a separate laundry room provide ample space for family and guests. The shared garage offers one-to-two car tandem parking (depending on size) and exclusive storage areas. This home is part of an exceptional  2-unit HOA building, ensuring a well-maintained and cohesive community
